title: CLI metadata contract
description: Observed software, agent, release, and launch information for the exact CLI binary used by one run.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js version when Node participates in launching or collecting the run; empty when not recorded.

packageName.description: Installed CLI package or executable family.

gitHead.description: CLI source commit when the binary was built locally; empty when unavailable.

agent.description: Identity and release provenance of the running agent.

agentId.description: Canonical agent or runtime configuration ID.

agentVersion.description: Model/version label reported by the agent protocol.

agentApplicationVersion.description: Actual CLI release version obtained from the binary or release artifact.

cliLaunchCommandName.description: Executable name invoked by the benchmark runner.

cliCommand.description: Complete launch command used for reproducibility. Consumers should redact secrets before publication.

pluginSkillGithubUrls.description: GitHub URLs of plugins or skills loaded into this run.

githubRepositoryUrl.description: Canonical source repository for the agent CLI.

releasePageUrl.description: Release page corresponding to agentApplicationVersion; null when that release did not publish a stable page.

releaseDownloadUrl.description: Exact downloadable binary/archive used when known.

releaseSha256.description: SHA-256 of the release artifact; null only when it was not recoverable.

model.description: Real normalized model ID used by this run.

effort.description: Real reasoning effort used by this run.

model_configuration.description: Requested and effective adapter model resolution captured before launch.

createdAt.description: Time this metadata contract was generated, not necessarily the run start time.
